description.narrative:
Impact: SRHR is upheld and promoted in UN intergovernmental spaces, progress is being made, and rollbacks are reduced.
End of Strategy Outcomes 1. Increased and diversified governmental base of support and leadership for SRHR at the UN. 2. UN intergovernmental outcome documents protect and advance priority SRHR language.
Nexus’s approach during Phase 3 Strategy (2025-2028) will be to i) develop and implement negotiation strategies for key UN negotiations; ii) coordinate these strategies with like-minded governments, UN agencies, and CSOs; iii) influence ‘middle-ground’ countries to motivate them to actively support SRHR (or encourage them not to join action intended to oppose SRHR).
The Nexus Initiative encourages governments to strengthen their commitment to, and increase the effectiveness of, their support to SRHR in UN fora. Governments and their UN permanent missions are the active parts in the Nexus Initiative, supported by a small and lean Secretariat overseeing international negotiations in New York and Geneva.
